literal.string: Test cases for the textual syntax (#497/#710)
do either { x := readFile path, y := decode x, y }
do effect: bare non-final clause uses wildcard binder
do list: single result clause (no bind)
Monadic 'do' sugar (#811): parse-only; 'do <tag> { clauses }' desugars to <tag>s.bind chains
ifElse: lazy then/else branches print with 'lazy' keyword
findWithDefault: lazy default value prints with 'lazy' keyword
∀k,v.lazy v → k → Map k v → v
optionals.match: lazy default value prints with 'lazy' keyword
no lazy parameters: no 'lazy' keyword appears
Round-trip and exact-print test cases for lazy parameter syntax (#800)
no local-name collision: imports are still aliased (round-trip identity)

module hydra.example.app

import hydra.core.error.file as error.file
import hydra.core.file as file

type Thing = (file.FilePath, error.file.FileError)
local-name collision: both sides are aliased, never bare

module hydra.app

import hydra.b as b

type T1 = a.Foo

type T2 = (a.Foo, b.Foo)
three non-colliding dependencies: all three are still aliased
